original_prompt: My github is logged into and actions are available through gh on cli. The organization for Sulcus is digitalforgeca under my (mcdoolz) account. Feel free to generate the public and private repositories thereon. Let's generate these in a fashion whereby we have tests and whatnot. We don't need a complete CI/CD pipeline but enough that we have a test suite and the badges to prove the builds even if we're updating the readme.md via local git hook and script. As an expert software project manager, cto and ai researcher, generate the repositories, post the code, ensure the documentation is solid, ensure there are tests showing build status, let's tag some releases and ensure we have some sort of pipeline set up for ourselves in git and let's validate those git actions/flows to be working as they ought. Let's codify and scriptify our deployments and validate that they are easy peezy to perform. We're finished when we have a nice toolkit with which to work and have our code all online as it ought to be.
